periods.description: Periods of normal time: 1 (SET-16, a tournament game of one period) to 4.

breakSec.description: Between periods, and before and between extra-time periods.

halfwayBreak.description: A break halfway through each period of normal time (TMR-7).

clock.description: No longer chosen per match: the account's match screen sets it (TMR-11). Kept for older apps.

stoppingClock.description: The clock (TMR-15): true stops the match clock while play is stopped (a stoppage, the halfway break), as US high school (NFHS) and college (NCAA) games keep time, with no added time; it needs trackStoppage. Missing means it runs on, as the Laws have it.

stopForGoalsCards.description: With a stopping clock, recording a goal or a card stops it, until Start/Stop at the restart (TMR-15). Missing means on.

breakStoppage.description: With stoppage tracked, the halfway break's time is added on as stoppage (TMR-12). Missing means on: formats saved before the setting.

goalScorers.description: Ask the scorer's number for each goal (EVT-10). Missing means on: formats saved before this always asked.

goalTypes.description: Ask the goal type (goal, DFK, penalty, own goal) for each goal (EVT-8).

goldenGoal.description: With extra time, a goal in it ends the match, the scoring team winning (ET-6). Missing means off.

sinBins.description: Temporary dismissals (EVT-12): Sin bin in the watch's team menu, a countdown with the match clock. Missing means off.

sinBinSec.description: A sin bin's length (EVT-12). Missing means 10 minutes.

description: How a match is played: periods, breaks, extra time, penalties and what the watch records.
